text: I won’t be thought ‘quaint,’ to begin with; I’m not so in the least. I protest.” “That protest is one of the quaintest things I’ve ever heard,” Isabel answered with a smile. Lord Warburton was briefly silent. “You judge only from the outside--you don’t care,” he said presently. “You only care to amuse yourself.” The note she had heard in his voice a moment before reappeared, and mixed with it now was an audible strain of bitterness--a bitterness so abrupt and inconsequent that the girl was afraid she had hurt him.
